svg.title: VID prototype architecture
svg.desc: Four-layer architecture: frontend, backend API, CAMARA network APIs, and data/output layer showing how VID processes identity from enrollment to certificate.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the enrollment form collect?')
sendPrompt('How does the trust score display work?')
sendPrompt('What does the VID certificate screen show?')
sendPrompt('How does the consent manager work?')
sendPrompt('What does the API orchestrator do?')
sendPrompt('How does the AI trust engine score identity?')
sendPrompt('How is the VID certificate generated?')
sendPrompt('How does SIM swap detection work in CAMARA?')

svg.text: Each API returns yes / no — no raw data ever leaves the network

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the VID certificate contain?')
sendPrompt('How does third party verification work?')
sendPrompt('What is stored in the VID database?')
sendPrompt('How does the audit log work?')
